title: China to provide 5,000 AI training opportunities for developing countries: Xi (gov.cn / Xinhua, July 17, 2026)
notes: gov.cn (State Council portal, Xinhua), 2026-07-17. Xi keynote at 2026 World AI Conference + High-Level Meeting on Global AI Governance (Shanghai): China to provide developing countries 5,000 AI training/seminar opportunities over next 5 years. International AI application cooperation centers with ASEAN, League of Arab States, AU, CELAC, SCO, BRICS. Help 30 countries use AI-powered MAZU meteorological early warning system.
